summary: Ethan calls Seoyun: there's a big job at work that weekend and he may not get leave for the wedding; he hasn't asked yet and only he can do it. Seoyun reminds him Dad gave him a pepper and that 준수 would be stuck next to Mom alone; they agree not to tell Mom yet. Unresolved.

paragraphs.ko: 저녁에 이선은 혼자 집에 있었다. 한참 생각하다가 서윤이에게 전화를 했다.
paragraphs.en: In the evening, Ethan was home alone. After thinking for a long while, he called Seoyun.

paragraphs.ko: 서윤: "이선아, 무슨 일 있어? 목소리가 안 좋아. 밥은 먹었어?"
paragraphs.en: Seoyun: "Ethan, is something wrong? You don't sound good. Did you eat?"

paragraphs.ko: 이선: "서윤아… 나 서현 씨 결혼식에 가지 못할 수도 있어." 서윤: "뭐? 왜?"
paragraphs.en: Ethan: "Seoyun... I might not be able to go to Seohyun's wedding." Seoyun: "What? Why?"

paragraphs.ko: 이선: "그 주말에 휴가를 받지 못할 수도 있어. 지금 일이 너무 많아. 그 주말에 큰 일이 하나 있어."
paragraphs.en: Ethan: "I might not be able to get leave that weekend. There's way too much work right now. There's a big job that weekend."

paragraphs.ko: 서윤: "휴가 이야기는 했어?" 이선: "아직 말하지 못했어. 그리고 그 일은 다른 사람한테 주지 못해. 나만 할 수 있어."
paragraphs.en: Seoyun: "Did you bring up the leave?" Ethan: "I haven't been able to say anything yet. And I can't hand that job to someone else. Only I can do it."

paragraphs.ko: 서윤이는 조금 말이 없었다. "엄마가 정말 기다리는데. 아빠도. 아빠가 너한테 고추도 줬잖아." 우리 엄마 아빠한테 너는 이제 정말 중요한 사람이야.
paragraphs.en: Seoyun was quiet for a bit. "Mom is really looking forward to it. Dad too. Dad even gave you a pepper." To my mom and dad, you're a really important person now.

paragraphs.ko: 이선: "나도 알아. 나도 정말 가고 싶어. 그 생각 때문에 밤에 잘 자지 못했어."
paragraphs.en: Ethan: "I know. I really want to go too. I couldn't sleep well at night because of it."

paragraphs.ko: 서윤: "그리고 준수는? 너 없으면 혼자 엄마 옆에 앉아야 돼. 엄마 이야기 정말 길잖아." 이선: "그건 준수한테 정말 큰 문제네."
paragraphs.en: Seoyun: "And Junsu? Without you, he has to sit next to Mom alone. Mom's stories are really long, you know." Ethan: "That's a really big problem for Junsu."

paragraphs.ko: 서윤: "엄마한테는 내가 말할까?" 이선: "아니야, 아직 말하지 마. 나도 아직 잘 모르니까. 곧 다시 말해 줄게."
paragraphs.en: Seoyun: "Should I tell Mom?" Ethan: "No, don't tell her yet. I don't really know yet either. I'll tell you again soon."

paragraphs.ko: 서윤: "그래. 같이 기다리자. 그리고 이선아, 너 오면 엄마가 또 '더 먹어' 할 거야."
paragraphs.en: Seoyun: "Okay. Let's wait together. And Ethan, if you come, Mom will say 'eat more' again."

paragraphs.ko: 이선이 처음으로 웃었다. "그건 정말 좋아. 꼭 갈게."
paragraphs.en: For the first time, Ethan laughed. "That I'd really like. I'll make it, I promise."

paragraphs.ko: 전화가 끝나고 이선은 다시 컴퓨터 앞에 앉았다. 오늘 밤에도 할 일이 정말 많았다.
paragraphs.en: After the call, Ethan sat back down at his computer. He had a lot of work to do again tonight.

questions.prompt_ko: 이선은 왜 결혼식에 가지 못할 수도 있어요?
questions.prompt_en: Why might Ethan not be able to go to the wedding?

questions.prompt_ko: 이선이 결혼식에 안 오면 준수는 어떻게 돼요?
questions.prompt_en: If Ethan doesn't come, what happens to Junsu?

questions.prompt_ko: "밤에 잘 자___." (= I couldn't sleep well.) 뭐가 맞아요?
questions.prompt_en: "I ___ sleep well at night." Which is right?
